items.summary: Deputy Health Minister Hanifah says she doesn’t have any update on if or when a minister’s exemption order to remove liquid nicotine from the Poisons List will be gazetted because this is under the health minister’s responsibility. items.title: What Proton Therapy In Singapore Can And Can’t Treat, Say Radiation Oncologists
items.summary: Proton beam therapy, which Malaysians can access in Singapore, is used to treat certain early-stage or locally advanced cancers, such as head and neck, brain, lung, and liver cancers, in patients suitable for curative treatment, say radiation oncologists. items.title: Anaesthesiologists Raise Potential Quality, Safety Issues With Generic Spinal Anaesthetic Drug
items.summary: Anaesthesiologists in Malaysian public hospitals raise serious potential quality and safety issues with Bupispine, a generic spinal anaesthesia drug (bupivacaine) manufactured by an Indian company. At least one failure was reported in a C-section surgery. The post Anaesthesiologists Raise Potential Quality, Safety Issues With Generic Spinal Anaesthetic Drug appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Malaysia’s Pork Imports Surge More Than Fivefold In Five Years
items.summary: Malaysia’s pork imports surged 5.5-fold between 2020 and 2025, meeting about 37% of domestic requirements. KPKM approved 181 importer registrations from 11 countries, while live pig exports remain limited to Singapore. items.title: Johor Cardiothoracic Service Head Quits Due To Frustration
